answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a multi-epoch cooling period, like a glacier, while existing raters can slash it if the account farms identities. A sudden gale of clones then becomes expensive: every extra name ties up capital and waits. Reputation is not a single score but a prism of independent signals—bond age, slash history, and cross-attested work—so one forged path cannot mint many trusted identities.
